title: [.Net][Feature Request]: Add support for OpenAI o1-preivew model
body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

The existing `OpenAIChatClientAgent` needs a little twist in order to work with o1-preview model
- make system message optional, because o1 doesn't support system message
- don't set temperature/max token when it's null, because o1 doesn't allow setting these fields


### Describe the solution you'd like

_No response_

_No response_
